title: Microtomographic reconstruction of mandibular defects treated with xenografts and collagen-based membranes: A pre-clinical minipig model
authors: Gomez J, Bergamo ET, Tovar N, Talib HS, Pippenger BE, Herdia V, Cox M, Coelho PG, Witek L. Med Oral Patol Oral Cir Bucal. 2021 Nov;26(6):e825-e833. doi: 10.4317/medoral.24811.
supports: Pre-clinical study from the botiss cerabone (sintered bovine bone) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “Volumetric analysis yielded a favorable mandible shape with respect to time through the beneficial balance between graft resorption/bone regenerative capacity for the natural bovine bone graft” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
